core_question: How concentrated is economic value across the customer base, and which relationships sit in the economically important head and long tail?
objective: Measure customer revenue and contribution Pareto distribution without turning distribution bands into automatic actions.

signals.core_question: How concentrated is economic value across the customer base, and which relationships sit in the economically important head and long tail?
signals.evidence_summary: 14 of 26 customers account for at least 80% of captured annual revenue. This describes economic distribution, not customer quality.
